name: Instant Coffee
siboNotes: Black instant coffee is well-tolerated for SIBO as it contains no FODMAPs. Avoid adding milk, cream, or sweeteners that may trigger symptoms.
preparationTips: Use hot water to dissolve instant coffee granules completely
Start with smaller amounts if sensitive to caffeine
Avoid adding milk - use lactose-free alternatives instead
Stick to plain instant coffee without added flavors or creamers
nutritionalHighlights: Source of potassium and magnesium in small amounts
